device: Microsoft SQ2 / Surface Pro X (Adreno 690 marketed name)
voltage_policy: Legacy 590/661 generation retains corner416. The default SQ2 profile requests432 at661/700; all lower OPPs remain unchanged. These are firmware corners, not guessed millivolt values.

provenance.comparison: SC8280XP uses a separate A690.0 GPU/GMU path; its 655 MHz TURBO and 690 MHz TURBO_L1 entries are reference only. This is not proof that its lower-corner curve applies to SQ2.
provenance.target_661_mhz: Operator-specified SQ2 maximum. This frequency-to-corner pairing is experimental, not an extracted OEM voltage curve.

thermal_policy.module: qcom_tsens.ko for 6.3.8-sq2-android1, loaded before Android init
thermal_policy.cooling: Existing MSM devfreq cooling device, all states
thermal_policy.missing_sensor: Load-test script refuses to proceed; 661 MHz boot refuses a failed TSENS module load.

limits: Short functional/load tests do not establish OEM voltage equivalence, long-term stability or measured physical PLL frequency. a6xx_gmu_get_freq returns a cached requested frequency. See deployment-status.json for actual test/deployment results.
default_build: scripts/build-source-boot.py automatically emits pinned700/432 and separate514 rescue DTBs; disk build and deployment verify both hashes.
default_validation: SQ2 Android boot confirmed at700/432. Load and long-term stability not yet tested. Do not conflate with earlier700/416 tests. RPMh432 is a corner code, not mV.
